t: Catch Me Up With Jon Leiberman
d: The news show for people who don't watch the news. Jon Leiberman (Howard Stern and America's Most Wanted) hosts this recap of the most important, compelling and craziest stories of the week.
Don't miss the wildest, wackiest and most jaw-dropping videos from dangerous severe weather to heart-stopping close calls to adorable animal antics -- all caught on video.

Planes grounded across America. Banking websites go offline. Microsoft goes dark — disrupting users around the world. Why did so many critical systems fail in the span of just a few days? Are we under cyberattack?

t: Dark Side of the Ring: Buff and The Bagwells
d: Marcus "Buff" Bagwell's brash persona in the ring was easily matched by his wild antics outside of it, made even wilder by the eccentric family he brought along for the ride.
